t01-ana-salt-luis.observed_description: At a dinner table Ana hands a small salt shaker to Luis, who reaches for it.
t01-ana-salt-luis.note: Can you pass the salt, please? (Luis asks, Ana passes.)

t02-sofia-sugar-diego.note: Can you pass the sugar, please? (Diego asks, Sofia passes.)

t03-diego-water-ana.observed_description: At a lunch table Diego hands a glass of water to Ana, who takes it.
t03-diego-water-ana.note: Can you pass the water, please? (Ana asks, Diego passes.)

t04-luis-bread-sofia.observed_description: Luis and Sofia far away at a small table, passing something small.

t05-piece-of-cake.observed_description: One piece of chocolate cake on a small plate with a fork, the rest of the cake behind it.

t06-sofia-cake-diego.observed_description: Sofia holds out a plate with a piece of chocolate cake to Diego, who smiles and takes it.
t06-sofia-cake-diego.note: Would you like a piece of cake? Yes, please.
